driver_ui.location_disclosure_body: Samskruthe School Nawabpet collects precise location data to enable live bus tracking for assigned parents, automatic stop-arrival updates, and route-stop calibration during an active bus trip, even when the app is not in use. The location is sent to the school's server so these features work while your screen is off or you use another app. Collection stops when the trip ends. We do not use location for advertising or sell it.
